description: Grove, the AI gateway, and the control credential Press calls it with. Every Product Trial site gets one Grove key under the trial team there, capped at the trial key cap for the life of the key and retired at the trial key expiry, written into the site config as ai_keys.

fields.description: The Grove site that serves AI, e.g. https://grove.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Grove URL

fields.description: What one trial site may spend through its key in all, USD. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it.
fields.label: Trial Key Cap (USD)

fields.description: Minted by Grove for Press on Enroll.
fields.label: Control Credentials

fields.description: Give every new Product Trial site a Grove key, written into its site config as ai_keys. Off, nothing new is minted; requests already made still run, and archived sites' keys are still revoked.
fields.label: Enable for Product Trials

fields.description: The Grove Team trial keys are minted under, one per site, titled by the site. Registered at Grove on Enroll and again when this name changes; a key keeps the team it was minted under.
fields.label: Trial Team

fields.description: When a trial key retires on its own: so many days after the mint, Grove revokes it. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it.
fields.label: Trial Key Expiry

name: Grove Settings
